newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel to requote on Oct 8 - SBF.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel to requote on Oct 8 - SBF.

text.p: Eurotunnel SA/Plc is scheduled to be requoted on October 8, the French stockmarkets association SBF said on Monday.
It said the stock, suspended at 9.15 francs on September 30, would be requoted at the normal hour. The bourse opens at 0800 GMT.

Brokers said they expect the share to rebound to between 10.50 and 12 francs after the announcement of a debt restructuring plan which leaves shareholders with 54.5 percent of the capital. But they said the rise would probably be followed by profit-taking.
"The plan looks a little better than what had been leaked in the press," a dealer said.
Another trader said the biggest positive factor was the reduction in interest rates on its debt to 5.20 percent for the next seven years.
